name: OpenTelemetry
summary: OpenTelemetry is a vendor-neutral, open-source framework for generating, collecting and exporting telemetry: traces, metrics and logs. Its wire protocol, OTLP, sends that data over gRPC or HTTP to a collector or any compatible backend; OpenTelemetry does not store or display data itself. This option covers plain OTel export, where each product chooses its own event names and attributes; the GenAI semantic conventions are listed separately.
facts: Protobuf, binary or JSON over HTTP
Stable for traces, metrics and logs; profiles in development
None of its own; export to a collector or compatible backend
goodFor: Sending agent activity to an existing observability stack
Avoiding lock-in to one tracing vendor
Combining agent telemetry with other services' telemetry
watchOut: A transport and data model only; each product sets its own event names
Needs a collector or backend to store and query the data
Exported events can carry prompts or file paths, depending on settings
